Let $f(x)=\int_{-1}^{1} t^2\cdot \tanh\left( {t^2}+1\right) dt$ be the integral at hand. We will use the recurrence method to find $f(x)$.
Since $\tanh\left( {t^2}+1\right)$ is expressed as the difference of two functions, namely $\text{sech}\left( {t^2}+1\right)$ and $\text{csch}\left( {t^2}+1\right)$, we have
$$
f(x)=\int_{-1}^{1} t^2\cdot(\text{sech}\left( {t^2}+1\right) - \text{csch}\left( {t^2}+1\right)) dt.
$$
Now, we can use integration by parts to find $f(x)$:
$$f(x)=\text{tanh}\left( {t^2}+1\right) \Big|_{-1}^{1} - \int_{-1}^{1} \text{sech}\left( {t^2}+1\right)\left( \dfrac{2t^3}{(1+t^2)^2}\right) dt
- \int_{-1}^{1} \text{csch}\left( {t^2}+1\right)\left( \dfrac{2t^3}{(1+t^2)^2}\right) dt.
$$
Notice that $\text{sech}\left( {t^2}+1\right)$ and $\text{csch}\left( {t^2}+1\right)$ are odd functions, so
$$\begin{aligned}
f(x)&=\text{tanh}\left( {t^2}+1\right) \Big|_{-1}^{1} \\
&= \text{tanh}\left( 2\right) - \text{sech}\left( 2\right) \\
&= 2\tanh\left( 2\right) - \sech\left( 2\right).
\end{aligned}
$$
This is the final non-recursive form for $f(x)$.
